title: Inter Women lose 3–1 at Real Madrid after a red card. Did the red decide it?
caption:
Inter Women lost 3–1 at Real Madrid in the Women's Champions League after a red card in the 41st minute, per Inter.it. Michela Cambiaghi tied it before halftime with ten players, and Inter still host Arsenal on December 16 with a knockout place possible. We say the red card decided it, not Madrid. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
